title: PWR-A plate-bonded power board, two-sided SHRINK-2 layout (PWR_MAIN + PWR_BRANCH + USB_POWER)
note: W2 PCB-PWRA-4: generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/make_board.py (do not hand-edit; rerun it) from the SHRINK-2 spec PWR_A.spec-shrink2.json and its placement study (W2 PCB-PWRA-3), with the placement changes of make_board.py MOVES, a GND plane via for every SMD GND pad, heights and height zones (hA, PWR-B windows, H-TRIM) and the router budget of a board of record. CI/MODEL only: no fabrication release, bench gates OPEN.

layers.source: W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6: 6 layers JLC06161H-2116 1.6 mm (the stackup of PWR_B and the 6-layer CTRL; pcb/generated/stackup-6l.json from pcb/stackup.py, jlcpcb.com/impedance read 2026-11-12), ordered with finished outer copper 2 oz and inner 0.5 oz (copper_option outer_2oz; jlcpcb.com/impedance, capabilities/pcb-capabilities and 6-layer-pcb read 2026-11-13). 1.6 mm is the order thickness; the contract gives PWR its own stackup (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR stackup: t 1.664 MODEL with 2 oz outer, order 1.6 +/- 10 %, W2 MECH-8), which the mechanics and the B2B stack row of placement_study use

plan.F.Cu: L1: parts (top), signals; BATT/PWR3A pours (scripted, locked tracks) and power routes at the 2 oz widths
plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND plane (pre-route zone, layer type power): every SMD GND pad joins it by its scripted via
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signal routes only (no power class: router.class_layers)
plan.In3.Cu: L4: signal routes only (no power class: router.class_layers)
plan.In4.Cu: L5: GND fill (pre-route plane, layer type power) with the scripted E1_CONV_IN strap/bridge pours of the LM61460 input at higher priority (the L3 role of the 4-layer plan)
plan.B.Cu: L6: bottom chips, signals; BATT/PWR3A pours paired with L1; GND bond copper in the four thermal_bond zones, solder mask on

layers.plan_source: W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6 (build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/make_board.py layers6); the 4-layer plan was build/15 W2 PCB-RULES
layers.types_why: S-G-S-S-P-S as PWR_B and the 6-layer CTRL: In1.Cu (L2) a solid GND plane 0.2234 mm under F.Cu and In4.Cu (L5) the GND fill 0.2234 mm over B.Cu, both of type power so Freerouting routes no trace on them; In2.Cu (L3) and In3.Cu (L4) are the two routing layers the stackup adds, each 0.3 mm from a plane. The power classes stay on the 2 oz outer copper (0.5 oz inner copper would need 1.8 mm for PWR1A and does not count for PWR3A/BATT, netclasses.json). The 4-layer probes routed power on typed-signal inner layers (sr-rx-pcb runs 42424071774, 42424538187), so class_layers keeps them out of In2/In3

rules_note: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it, so the net classes and project rules are mirrored in PWR_A.kicad_pro: classes SIG (Default) 0.15 and the power classes at their 2 oz outer widths of pcb/generated/stackup-6l.json copper_options outer_2oz (PWR1A 0.2, PWR2A 0.4, PWR3A 0.95, BATT 1.6 mm, MODEL), clearance 0.15; router vias 0.7/0.3; min through hole 0.2 because the KiCad LT3045 footprint MSOP-12-1EP ThermalVias drills 0.2 mm (JLC multilayer floor 0.15)

fab_floor.source: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities read 2026-11-07 (W2 PCB-PWRA-1), multilayer 1 oz values; the same numbers as pcb/generated/netclasses.json fab_floor.jlc_4l_1oz; W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6: 2 oz outer copper, so track and spacing take the 2 oz multilayer floor "Multilayer: 0.15 / 0.15 mm" (jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities read 2026-11-13)

power_stages.note: W2 PCB-PWRA-3 (design choice; review fixes F1/F2): anchored power stages and their scripted copper. Scripted: E1_SW from J107.2 to Q102; E1_CONV_IN from Q102 to both LM61460 VIN pins (each side with its CIN_HF and CIN, joined by the In2 VIN strap), C107 and both TPSM63606 VIN pins; SYS12 from L102.2 over COUT across the spine to the SYS12 node with F201.1, L202.1 and Q201.2; E1_LAB5_RAW from U108 VOUT to F102.1; E1_LAB5_FUSED from F102.2 to C111.1 and L101.1; LAB5 from L101.2 to C112.1, F104.1, L205.1 (the LT3045 feed) and the four J208 LAB5 contacts (F.Cu and B.Cu trunk). Left to the router (PCB-PWRA-4; placement_study.py corridor pre-check): the U107/U108 small-signal pins (FB, RT, EN, CBOOT, RBOOT, VCC, BIAS, PG) to their parts, the 0603 E1_CONV_IN bypass C132 at U108, the other LAB5 loads (J104, J206.2, U503, U553, C552, C509, C223, R110), E2_LNA_IN from L205.2 to the LT3045 IN pins and every branch net after F201, L202 and Q201

small_signal.rule: W2 PWR-L6-PLACE (placement only): the U107 and U108 small-signal parts anchored inside thermal_bond zones 3'/4' next to their pins (make_spec.py SMALL_SIGNAL_ANCHORS); MODEL geometry, pad centre to pin centre: CVCC <= 2.0 mm of VCC/AGND, CBOOT, RBOOT and the feedback parts <= 5.0 mm of their pins (project limits). Their copper (the SW-CBOOT link through the VIN2-RBOOT gap, the FB node on F.Cu only, AGND to PGND under U108) is W2 PWR-L6-SCRIPT's; the F.Cu VIN2 bar CONVIN-U107-L-BAR closes that gap today

exemption_policy.why: W2 PWR-L6-SCRIPT (synthesis PWR-L6-SCRIPT, judge 1 power rating): class-width exemptions follow the pad they serve. branch_exempt only for test points, resistors of 100 ohm or more and sense or logic pins; no neck on TVS, connector or harness lands, shunts, fuses, power-switch nodes, eFuse IN/OUT or converter capacitors; a neck at least as wide as its pad and no longer than it (no pin stems); pin entries are pours within half the class width of the pad

converter_zones.rule: W2 PWR-L6-SCRIPT: on F.Cu and In1.Cu over the converter zones 3'/4' (contract thermal_bond zones 3 and 4) only the nets with a pad inside the zone (own_nets) carry copper; In1.Cu is the solid GND plane under the converters. The scripted nets are not autorouted (scripted classes); freeze/plan6.py keeps the zones as F.Cu keep-outs for the other nets, freeze/freeze6.py drops router copper of other nets there; board_audit.py checks it (MODEL)
